r: Here are the top 8 players of the 2019 South America Dragon Duel WCQ:

Diego Romero from Peru, Enzo Salviati from Brazil, Santiago Castro from Argentina, Aucan Linconir from Chile, Adriano Cova from Venezuela, Henrique Miziara, Leonardo del Salto from Ecuador and Joaquin Gonzalez from Chile.

Diego Romero from Peru used his Salamangreat to win the South America Dragon Duel WCQ. This will be the second year in a row that Diego will be representing South America at the Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship.
